about: Evaluation set for Felix, the Larmor assistant (INTEGRATION.md: 20-30 real questions with expected answers; re-run after every prompt or docs change with: py tools/eval_assistant.py). A case passes when the answer contains every group in must_include (any one alternative per group, case-insensitive), none of must_not, and a Source line.
